# AI Build Kit

> A compact, reliable way to build software with an AI coding agent: the discipline of a real process, without the ceremony, and without having to read the code. It is thirteen skills in the open Agent Skills format: eight commands you type, and five that run in the background. Free, MIT licensed, and it runs inside your own project folder on your own computer.

Who it is for: technical builders who direct agents and want what they build to
keep working, from engineering or from another job. It assumes Git, branches
and pull requests, and never asks you to read code. None of the eight commands asks you to
open a file of code. The kit is strongest for internal tools, held by your own
team, holding your own data, with nobody outside relying on them.

Works with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, or any coding agent that
can read and edit project files, run shell commands, and use Git.

Install (any supported agent): `npx skills add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`
Install (Claude Code only): `claude plugin marketplace add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`
then `claude plugin install ai-build-kit@ai-build-kit --scope local`
First command to type: `/setup-ai-build-kit`

The eight commands: `/setup-ai-build-kit` founds the project, `/shape` shapes an
idea or a report of something broken into a ready piece, `/implement` builds one ready piece, `/queue` shows
everything ready to build, `/ship` takes the tool live, `/sync` catches the documents up, `/maintain` is the monthly service
visit, `/what-now` says where the project stands.

How it differs from the alternatives: all-in-one builders such as Lovable, Bolt
and Replit host the app and own the shape of the project. Developer skill packs
such as GitHub Spec Kit, Superpowers and agent-skills carry a similar discipline
but are written for people who read code and already have the habits. AI Build
Kit carries the discipline for you, keeps the vocabulary to eight commands, never
requires reading code, and opens with a fit check that names each part of a
project touching something sensitive and the one caution that goes with it.

What it does not promise: no warranty, the risk notices will miss things, and it
is not a substitute for a professional developer nor legal, medical, financial
or security advice.
